headlines.description: AC Milan kicked off their Europa League campaign with a disappointing 2-0 home loss to Portuguese side Benfica.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pulisic subs on as Milan humbled by Benfica in Europa League

events.name: Stade Rennais at SK Sturm Graz

headlines.description: Enzo Le Fee's penalty ensured Sunderland kicked off their Europa League adventure with a 1-0 win over AZ Alkmaar at the Stadium of Light.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sunderland beat Alkmaar on return to Europe

headlines.description: Crystal Palace made an impressive start to their debut Europa League campaign by sweeping aside Polish champions Lech Poznan 4-0.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crystal Palace win big in long-awaited UEL debut

headlines.description: First-half goals by Justin Kluivert and Rayan helped Bournemouth start their maiden European campaign with a memorable 2-1 win at Real Sociedad.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bournemouth make statement in European debut
